verdicts.reason: A keeps the lilac circle behind the can like the original, but the circle clips out the right edge and its top tucks under the Shop Sale button. In both, the text is jammed against the left edge at about 6px and 'only.' is orphaned. There is also dead space: roughly 80px empty at the top and roughly 90px at the bottom. B has the same problems and also moves the circle to the top-right corner, where it collides with the end of 'WEEKEND ONLY'. That also removes the circle-behind-product layering, so B is worse.
